claim: Recovery operations (abort, abandon, reconciliation) must stay callable after the authority deadline without extending the authority or authorizing dispatch; a deadline that blocks recovery strands held resources forever.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: reviewer found a single deadline doing two jobs; splitting admission and finalization from bounded recovery-call timeouts fixed the strand without weakening fail-closed.
